description: A sticky, adhesive fluid that ignites when exposed to air, creating persistent flames.
name: Alchemist's Fire
notes: In combat: throw it at a foe (Dexterity attack, range 2/3 squares): 1d4 fire, and it keeps burning for 1d4 a turn until it beats a DC 10 Dexterity save.
Used up whether it hits or not.
